text:
Nora (docs): quick sync 1 min - found two issues on the APAC region page: a broken link to the residency FAQ and a Python SDK snippet using 'apac-hk' alias.
Hassan (eng): which link is broken?
Nora (docs): /legal/data-residency -> returns 404 because we renamed the page. Should point to /legal/residency-policy.
Lina (intl): we need the English canonical URL before we push translations. Please don't change the slug again until i18n export is done.
Priya (legal): confirm we should link to the stable policy URL. I'll confirm the correct final URL and post it here.
Hassan (eng): for SDK snippet swap alias to canonical region code. Proposed sample: `client = RedwoodClient(region="ap-southeast-1", residency="retained")`.
Nora (docs): ok I'll update the snippet and add a one-line migration note: "If your scripts use legacy aliases (e.g., apac-hk), replace with canonical region codes before end of Q3."
Lina (intl): after merge I'll queue translations; i18n-bot please create tasks for ja/zh.
i18n-bot: translations queued: JOB-9001 (ja, zh).
Priya (legal): approved the wording; ensure the link targets /legal/residency-policy (stable).
Nora (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/517  fixes link and snippet, adds migration note. Tagging @Hassan and @Priya for quick review.
Hassan (eng): LGTM, tiny nit: wrap residency value in quotes in code block for clarity.
Nora (docs): fixed and merged. Follow-up ticket to sweep other SDK examples: DOCS-3239. Closing thread.
